ios.desc:
PDFonTV allows viewing PDF files on a large TV screen connected to your Apple TV. Upload any PDF file through your WiFi network to the PDFonTV app and read it on your TV.

How to upload a PDF file:

1. Enable WiFi transfer inside the app by clicking the button on the left side (it should change from OFF to ON).
2. Under the button web address will appear such as http://192.168.0.52:8787/
3. On your Mac/PC open a web browser such as Safari and go to the address displayed on your TV (note that your Mac/PC must be connected to the same WiFi network as your AppleTV).
4. Upload you PDF file using the web page displayed on your Mac/PC.
